lines.en: Every step of mine is planted firmly.
My shoulder cannon turns with my gaze.
I walk sideways to clear my firing line.
The steel on my back drums.
I take open ground; no crowds for me.

lines.zh: 我把脚抬高，怕踩塌东西。
lines.en: I lift my feet high so I won't crush things.
I cross a knoll and it flattens.
The scope slides across my vision.
I turn slowly; the muzzle follows.
I don't walk fast. I shoot far.
I stand with the muzzle forward.
I'm cooling the barrel.
This one is unit zero seven.
My load rides on my heels.
Ammo is short; I must be sparing.
I'm calculating range.
Coolant moves through the pipes.
My shadow is wider than my kin's.
I dislike close quarters.
I plant my stabilizers in the soil.

lines.zh: 远处的风偏了一点，我记下。
lines.en: The wind drifted; I note it.

lines.zh: 我背后那排管子在冒气。
lines.en: The pipes behind me vent steam.
The reticle never leaves you.
I straighten the belt so it won't jam.
I wait for the barrel to cool.
You're dead center in my range.
The closer you come, the harder my shot.
I've measured your distance.

lines.zh: 你别站在我炮口那条线上。
lines.en: Don't stand on my muzzle line.

lines.zh: 我这一台装的是重家伙。
lines.en: This unit carries heavy gear.
You rattle with metal.
My aim is steady.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块地，我标记了。
lines.en: I've marked the ground under you.
Back off so I can fire.
I can see you breathe.
Leave before I power up.
The plate is bent, exposing cables.
The barrel skewed half a degree; I adjust.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的装填口。
lines.en: That hit my breech.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，支架跟着挪。
lines.en: I step back; the stabilizer drags.
An indicator blinks twice.
My firing angle shifted.
A coolant line seeps.
I can still fire. Don't worry.
I'll have to recalculate for the next shot.
I don't eat. I load.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，抵不上一发。
lines.en: What you hold isn't worth one shell.
Put it away; it blocks the sight.

lines.zh: 那点热量，我连预热都不够。
lines.en: That heat won't even preheat me.
Bring ammunition and we'll talk.
You're talking to a muzzle.
I have no port for that.
Don't come closer. It's dangerous.
I recognize none of that.
Coax me and I aim better.
You hit my stabilizer; it holds.
My base is wide. I won't be pushed.
You're crowded to one side.
Don't lean on my barrel.

lines.zh: 我的外壳厚重，撞起来闷。
lines.en: My hull is thick; the knock is dull.
Step back; I need to turn.
That didn't shift me.
I reseat my stabilizers.
You stepped on my mount.
Brush my shoulder and you'll be scraped.
Another unit from the same batch.
Our serials are close.
Its barrel is longer than mine.
We aligned each other's sights.
We split duties: it close, me far.
It taps my breech.
We set up our positions together.
It fires first; I add the second.
Done, we each withdraw.
Who knows when we'll align barrels again.
I bend; my stabilizer lifts first.
I nudge it over with my barrel.
This pearl is too light.
I drop it into the ammo bin.
From the drops I take the heavy ones.
I pinch it up with a crisp click.
This can serve as ballast.

lines.zh: 我脚下有个弹壳，我踢开。
lines.en: A spent casing underfoot; I kick it away.
Stow it. It's in my firing line.
Done, I return to position.
My muzzle rising is the signal.
Range is right. No need to move.
You're a red dot on my display.
Hold still; moving makes it worse.
This unit handles the long range.
Stabilizers set. Firing.
Can your shield take one?
Cooling finished. Perfect timing.
You're standing in the open.
I've corrected for the wind.
The dirt under you goes first.
I fire from slightly higher ground.
I left margin on this shot.
Don't advance; I'll miscalculate.
Lock complete. Loading.
That armor won't stop a heavy shell.
I'm at the right range — no need to move.
The breech is hot.
Last warning. Walk away.

lines.zh: 你移到石头后面，石头不够厚。
lines.en: You're behind a rock. It's not thick enough.
I keep the muzzle on you, tracking slowly.

lines.zh: 你在跑，我的提前量也在变。
lines.en: You run; my lead changes with you.
I needn't run; I shoot far.
My stabilizers are set.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的准星也换。
lines.en: You change direction; the reticle follows.
You're high up. Clear line of sight.
I'm counting down your range.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地面我都记着。
lines.en: I've noted every patch you crossed.
I wait for the cooldown. No hurry.
The moment you stop, I lock.

lines.zh: 我的影子把地面分成了两半。
lines.en: My shadow halves the ground.

lines.zh: 你再躲，也只是换个角度。
lines.en: Dodging only changes the angle.
I've lowered my muzzle.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，墙会替你挡一下。
lines.en: At the wall, the wall blocks one shot.
I've swept my firing arc.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我算进去了。
lines.en: Your footfalls are in my calculation.
I'm still loading. Hurry.
Closer and I needn't aim.
The muzzle flashes; a hole opens in the ground.

lines.zh: 这一发直接砸在你的盾上。
lines.en: This one lands square on your shield.

lines.zh: 爆炸把碎石推到你身上。
lines.en: The blast throws gravel into you.
I sweep with the barrel.
I can still fight at close range.
The blast rings in your ears.

lines.zh: 这一发偏了半格，我不满意。
lines.en: That one drifted half a mark. Unsatisfying.
The second shell is already chambered.
I shove with my stabilizer.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我自己也推了一下。
lines.en: The blast pushes me back too.
Your armor dents badly.
That should send you another way.
I bring a foot down where you'll land.
I'm set up with the muzzle facing out.
Someone loaded me.
My rangefinder sweeps once.
The stabilizers drop and bite the soil.

lines.zh: 这是零七号机体，已就位。
lines.en: Unit zero seven, in position.
First I corrected for wind.
Wide field of view here.

lines.zh: 我的冷却管开始运作了。
lines.en: My coolant lines start running.

lines.zh: 我扫了一圈，标了几个点。
lines.en: I scan once and mark a few points.
The muzzle rises, aimed far off.
I don't intend to come close.

lines.zh: 地面被我的重量压出四个坑。
lines.en: My weight leaves four pits.

lines.zh: 有人把这个型号也叫 Boss。
lines.en: Some call this model a boss too.
My ammo bin is full.

lines.zh: 这个世界的天空，太干净。
lines.en: This world's sky is too clean.
I land and the dust spreads in a ring.
First level the stabilizers.
My arc is clear for now.
The smell of the barrel is familiar.

lines.zh: 火烤着炮管，我担心里面的药。
lines.en: Fire heats the barrel; I worry about the charge.
On landing, the stabilizers all bend.

lines.zh: 水灌进炮膛，我彻底哑了。
lines.en: Water in the barrel and I'm silenced.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的弹药箱震得直响。
lines.en: The blast rattles my ammo bin.

lines.zh: 弹丸打在我瞄准镜上，裂了。
lines.en: A round cracks my scope.

lines.zh: 光进到电路里，测距全乱。
lines.en: Light gets into the circuits; ranging goes wild.
Out of shells; I can only stand.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的炮管上，麻了半边。
lines.en: Lightning hits my barrel; half of me goes numb.
I fall with the muzzle pointing up.
